title: Reconstructed tower mate satisfies the integral counit transpose identity
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $b,o,q$ be the specified strict-tower operations and coordinates. Let $g_X:X'\to X$, $g_Y:Y'\to Y$, $f:X\to Y$ and $f':X'\to Y'$ be a Cartesian scheme square with a compactification $c$ of $f$ and its prescribed Cartesian pullback. Assume $\ell$ is invertible in every residue field at all four vertices. Fix tower adjunction data $a$ and compatible integral data $s$, including the four normalized reduction/limit coordinates, actual support and right-adjoint comparisons, and their counit and pullback normalization equations. These are the data and functors of [def-pur-integral-geometric-comparison-data, det-sp-tower-exceptional-bc]. Fix open-exchange data $x$, invertibility of the actual tower support exchange, and a natural integral support exchange isomorphism $\beta$ whose entire reduction is exchangeReduction. For every integral constructible $K$ on $Y$, the already defined reconstructed tower mate equals integralTranspose for $\beta$. No invertibility of the exceptional mate is assumed and no new geometric or comparison data are asserted to exist.

proof.text:
apply red_Y' to the integral adjunct-counit equation. Substitute s.counit,
s.counit', the beta reduction equation, and the two pullback comparison naturality
squares. Full faithfulness identifies the reduction of reconstructed with the conjugated
actual tower mate. Naturality of supportComparison moves that conjugation past F', and
naturality of exceptionalComparison and the two counits cancels its target factor.
The resulting equation is the defining tower mate counit equation. Thus faithfulness
of red_Y' gives the integral counit equation. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence then
identifies reconstructed with integralTranspose. This uses whole-tower maps only;
neither evaluation nor scalar restriction is assumed faithful. The calculation is
valid for any coefficient extension and also for a zero object or an identity square.

lean.statement:
theorem integral_geometric_transpose_identity
    (x : SpTowerShriek.OpenExchange l E b o)
    (hb : IsIso (SpTowerMate.beta l E b o q a x))
    (beta : SpIntegralAdjunction.support l E c s.support_closed ⋙
        constructibleIntegralPullback l E gy ≅
      constructibleIntegralPullback l E gx ⋙
        SpIntegralAdjunction.support l E (c.ofIsPullback sq) s.support_closed')
    (hbeta : ∀ M : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X,
      (SpExceptionalBaseChange.red l E b q s.rY').map (beta.hom.app M) =
        SpExceptionalBaseChange.exchangeReduction l E b o q a s x M)
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y) :
    SpExceptionalBaseChange.reconstructed l E b o q a s x hb K =
      SpExceptionalBaseChange.integralTranspose l E b o q a s beta K
